summary: De Brauw Blackstone Westbroek is dutch law firm headquartered in Amsterdam, founded in 1871. Type: private company. About 888 employees (LinkedIn page). Recognised visa sponsor (IND). 100% of its 3 jobs here don't ask for Dutch. News, last 3 months: 1 about funding.

LinkedIn page (existing data, collected via Apify; LinkedIn terms forbid scraping)

insights.one_liner: Amsterdam law firm founded in 1871, calling itself the leading international law firm in the Netherlands, with a separate training track for international graduates.

culture.text: About 888 people on LinkedIn; most studied law at the University of Amsterdam, Leiden, Utrecht, VU Amsterdam or Groningen.
Work centres on corporate/M&A, litigation and arbitration, and compliance, with lawyers expected to team up across legal and non-legal disciplines.
Describes its people as courageous team-players with grit and curiosity, and says it works on headline cases with the best in the field.
Headquartered in Amsterdam with offices in Brussels, London, Shanghai and Singapore.

open.text: IND recognised visa sponsor (De Brauw Blackstone Westbroek N.V.).
Runs The Brewery, a training institute specifically for international graduates, next to De Brauwerij for Dutch law graduates.
Also offers short-term work as a Law Assistant or Student Trainee.

growth.text: Recent work includes advising CureVac on its IPO and Nasdaq listing and Philips on buying NightBalance.

worth_knowing.text: Dutch firms dominated the Legal 500 recommendation list, per the headline.
More and more international law firms are entering the Dutch market, meaning more competition for the same talent.
